content.text: In many regions, including Nigeria and Venezuela, conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal remain inaccessible, leaving digital creators stranded. COREMERCH offers a robust alternative with its comprehensive digital commerce stacks, enabling you to deploy a fully operational online store without these traditional restrictions. This guide will walk you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-about-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-guide-3|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-14|Setting Up]]-up-nowpayments-digital-store-step-step-deployment-8|setting]] up your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, leveraging Stack 02, which is deployed by COREMERCH in just 48 hours and fully tested before you take over. You can effectively process crypto payments, own your data, and maintain operational sovereignty.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, creating a resilient infrastructure that does not rely on mainstream payment platforms. This architecture ensures you have full ownership of your data and products, eliminating the risk of freezing accounts or payment holds. The flexibility of using Workers allows for custom backend logic, and Supabase provides a database solution that is both powerful and cost-effective. With NOWPayments integrated for crypto transactions, you can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies seamlessly. This setup is designed to empower creators in areas where traditional payment infrastructures have failed.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting your deployment, you need to gather essential tools and accounts. First, create a Cloudflare account to access Pages and Workers. You will also need a Supabase account for database management. Familiarize yourself with GitHub, as version control will be critical. Make sure to have a NOWPayments account ready to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, prepare your digital products for upload—ebooks, courses, or templates. By lining up these resources, you streamline your deployment process and ensure everything is ready for an efficient setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once your accounts are ready, start by deploying your Cloudflare Pages site. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint to set up your application code on GitHub. Configure the NOWPayments integration to handle crypto transactions—its straightforward API will guide you through. Next, leverage Cloudflare Workers to manage backend logic, enabling you to create custom delivery workflows for your digital products. Use Supabase to store and manage your orders securely. This seamless integration will ensure payments are processed efficiently, and products are delivered automatically upon successful transactions.
Fully own your digital products and customer data without platform restrictions.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, it’s time to go live. Test your integration thoroughly in the Cloudflare environment to ensure everything functions as intended. Once confirmed, publish your site and promote it through your channels. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the transaction on-chain, triggering your delivery pipeline. This immediate response ensures that your customers receive their products instantly, enhancing their experience and building trust in your digital storefront.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure successfully deployed and operational, focus on scaling your efforts. Monitor your sales and product downloads through Supabase to identify trends and customer preferences. Consider adding more products or diversifying your offerings based on customer feedback. Explore promotional strategies to enhance visibility and attract more customers. The Edge Commerce Stack allows for additional features, such as SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations, which can improve your email deliverability for marketing campaigns. Continuous improvement and adaptation are key to maintaining growth.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your store in just 48 hours with end-to-end tested infrastructure.

For those looking for a more advanced setup, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which offers additional features and support. Explore your options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to find the best fit for your needs.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store by deploying on Cloudflare Pages using COREMERCH's Stack 02, which integrates Workers for backend logic and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup is cost-effective and empowers you with complete control.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a simpler setup using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, focusing on a quick deployment within 4-6 hours. Stack 02, however, offers more robust features with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours with comprehensive end-to-end testing.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both platforms. GitHub Pages is suitable for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages provides more advanced capabilities, especially when integrated with Workers and Supabase.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for crypto transactions?
NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without KYC requirements. The low transaction fee of 0.5% and instant payment confirmations enhance the efficiency of your digital store.
How can I ensure my digital store is secure?

Implement security features such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC to protect your email communications. Use HTTPS for your site on Cloudflare Pages and ensure your payment processing through NOWPayments is configured correctly to mitigate fraud risks.
